status: frozen before this evaluator reads test model outputs
dataset_namespace: Test/PAPER/<name> and Test/EXTRA/<id>, distinct from Training/<id>
checkpoint_selection: Best original validation mean PSNR-mu within fixed 50000 updates. All selected step 50000; checkpoint SHA256 frozen.

preprocessing.flow: DIS medium, exposure matching, original-source backward warp
preprocessing.inference: full scene, no resize, no test-time augmentation, FP32 TF32 disabled

primary_metric: Arithmetic mean full-image PSNR-mu over all 15 scenes. Also report PAPER(5) and EXTRA(10) separately.
decision_rule: Evaluate all frozen methods on every scene; save per-scene and means. Never tune checkpoints, thresholds or scale on test targets. If a scene fails, mark run incomplete, retain records and investigate before claiming all-scene means.
overlap_checks: SHA256 of input TIFFs versus every Training TIFF; grayscale middle-image NCC 48x72 >=0.9 flagged for review. Exact duplicate stops the run; similarity flags require human review and are not silently removed.

figure_policy.selection: Choose explanatory cases and 256x256 textured/moving regions using input exposures, before predictions/target are displayed. Record boxes and rationale. Show all15 in a contact sheet.
figure_policy.display: One scene-wide reference-derived Reinhard exposure + gamma 1/2.2 for every output and target. Never per-method enhancement. Scores use original float radiance and fixed mu mapping.
figure_policy.error_maps: Fixed shared 0..0.05 absolute mu-error, fixed +/-0.02 M3-minus-M2 absolute error difference, clearly marked display saturation.
figure_policy.scope: Figures illustrate behavior and do not define which scenes enter test means. If post-hoc best/worst cases are added, label selection explicitly and include both directions.

PAPER/PeopleTalking.reason: Moving head/face of the foreground person is visible across the three input exposures. Selected from LDR inputs only, before inspecting model predictions or HDR target previews.

limitations: Within-dataset holdout does not resolve the instructors concern about easy/small-motion benchmarks. Challenge123 remains necessary for broader robustness.
Current models have one training seed. Inference checks do not establish seed robustness.
